content.title: Harley-Davidson Shares Fall Despite Earnings Beat; Sales Slump Persists
content.summary: Harley-Davidson shares were down 4.7% on Tuesday afternoon as slipping motorcycle sales outweighed better-than-expected quarterly earnings.  The Milwaukee-based motorcycle maker reported adjusted third-quarter earnings of $3.10 a share, more than double the $1.53 prediction of Wall Street analysts polled by Factset.  Harley reported that quarterly motorcycle sales fell 5% in North America and 6% globally, extending a long-running slump.
